title: ContentLabels
description: common.content-labels@1 (L1, labels and choices, 2026-10-31): what a stream, VOD, clip, picture or post is labelled as, and what the AI has suggested but the creator has not confirmed. Labels are choices, never bans: a label never hides content from the person who posted it, and it never hides content from a viewer whose label preferences show it. A creator sets a label; the AI may only suggest one (a suggestion the creator confirms, never a takedown); three viewer suggestions or a moderator put one on. The label set is one list everywhere: nudity, language, graphic, 18+, flashing and spoilers.

labels.description: The labels in force: set by the creator, or by a moderator, or by three viewer suggestions. A label never hides anything by itself; each viewer's prefs decide (network.label-prefs@1).

suggested.description: What the AI or a viewer suggested and nobody confirmed yet. Stored as a suggestion and never applied: a label in this list changes nothing for anyone until the creator (or a moderator) puts it in labels.

label.description: nudity: nudity or sexual content; language: strong language; graphic: graphic violence or injury; 18+: adults only; flashing: flashing lights or rapid motion; spoilers: spoils a story.
